title: Accounts and login
chunks: Riders and drivers should keep their DUDU Car account phone number and profile information up to date. For login problems, try updating the app, checking the phone number used for registration, and requesting a new verification code. Never share passwords, OTPs, or private account codes in chat.

title: Bookings and cancellations
chunks: Riders can request a ride in the DUDU Car app by confirming pickup, destination, and fare estimate before booking. Cancellation rules may depend on timing, driver assignment, and local policy. The support bot cannot cancel rides directly, but can create a support ticket if a cancellation caused a problem.

title: Fares and payments
chunks: Fare estimates can change due to distance, time, traffic, tolls, waiting time, promotions, or route changes. If a rider believes a fare or payment is incorrect, collect the trip ID, payment method type, and a short description, then create a support ticket for human review. Do not collect full payment card numbers.

title: Promotions and vouchers
chunks: Promotions and vouchers may have expiry dates, usage limits, eligible service areas, minimum fare requirements, and account-specific conditions. If a promo does not apply, ask the user to check the voucher terms and app version. Create a ticket if the user believes the promotion should have worked.

title: Driver onboarding basics
chunks: Drivers usually need to complete profile, vehicle, and document checks before accepting trips. Document approval depends on completeness, validity, and DUDU Car policy. The bot should not approve or reject drivers directly; it can explain general onboarding steps and create a ticket for review.

title: Safety incidents
chunks: Safety issues such as accidents, threats, harassment, assault, or immediate danger must be treated as urgent. If anyone is in immediate danger, advise them to contact local emergency services first. With consent, collect only the relevant details and create an urgent support ticket. The first human response target for an urgent ticket is within 24 hours. Confirmed human coverage is 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM every day in Malaysia time; do not promise 24/7 human coverage.

title: Support ticket response targets
chunks: DUDU Car support tickets have first-human-response targets based on priority: normal tickets within 3 to 5 days, high-priority tickets within 1 to 3 days, and urgent tickets within 24 hours. These are first-response targets, not resolution promises. Confirmed human coverage is 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM every day in Malaysia time. Before creating a ticket, obtain consent and collect the user's name and email address.

title: Business collaboration inquiries
chunks: Businesses and organizations interested in collaborating with DUDU Car may ask the chatbot for approved general partnership information. The chatbot may collect the contact person's name, email address, organization name, and a short summary after consent, then create a normal-priority ticket for human follow-up. The chatbot cannot approve a partnership, negotiate terms, or make commitments on behalf of DUDU Car.
